description.narrative:
The intervention proposed addresses urgent humanitarian needs based on government assessments in coordination with United Nations agencies and local authorities in the hardest-hit areas of Mecufi and Chiure districts. Oxfam will work together with a long-standinglocal partner (ADEL CD) in Chiure and Montepuez, where the partner already has a base and accumulated experiences targeting the critical unmet needs of the most vulnerable with funding of CHAF. Specific Activities will be as follows (i) Voucher/Cash Based Programming (1,550 individuals/310 families): Support the most vulnerable families with vouchers/ cash for emergency and lifesaving basic needs for example food, family kits (household utensils, blankets, hygiene materials and clothes) to the most vulnerable households that lost their possessions. (ii) Gender and Protection (5,000 women and girls in fertility age): Distribute dignity kits to women and girls of sexual and reproductive age, which will include IEC material to help them address, report and seek support for protectionand risks of gender-based violence gender. Gender equality will be incorporated into all activities, adhering to Oxfam’s Gender in Emergencies guidelines. An analysis and monitoring of gender inequalities will be carried out to inform and target project needs andensure that interventions are inclusive and sensitive to the specific needs of women and girls.
Oxfam will maintain frequent communication with local government authorities and clusters led by the United Nations and with the entire humanitarian community to ensure a coordinated and complementary response, encouraging the exchange and sharing of information and challenges, avoiding overlaps and increasing reach and depth to the most vulnerable populations affected by the cyclone. Oxfam will work in coordination with organizations with a strong presence in Cabo Delgado, namely CARE International, Save the Children, Plan International, Agha Khan Foundation, Doctors Without Borders, INSO (for monitoring, analysis and management of security aspects), to expand and strengthen its response capacity. Oxfam's protection activities will focus on raising awareness about protection risks and providing affected populations, especially women and girls, with information on available services and how to access support safely. The response will include voucher/cash-for-protection initiatives, referrals to specialized services, psychological first aid, and inclusive, culturally sensitive approaches to enhance dignity and resilience.
OUTCOME 1.0: Improved HHs immediate relief needs:
Number of participants: 1550individuals/ 310HH
Core Results Indicator: 1550 individuals receive unconditional cash. Activity 1.1.1: Conduct monthly market assessments/ monitoring. Activity 1.1.2: Training target HH and services providers on cash voucher assistance Activity 1.1.3: Conduct 2 months multi-propose voucher (150 Euros) distribution to 310 most vulnerable families for immediate relief needs such as food, family kits (household utensils, blankets, hygiene materials and clothes) Activity 1.1.4: Post Distribution Monitoring.
OUTCOME 2.1: Strengthened protection for Sexual, Abuse and Exploitation of women and girls.
Number of participants: 5000 women, and girls
Core Results Indicator: 5000 women and girls receive dignity kits. Activity 2.1.1: Beneficiary registration, validation, and establishment of feedback, help desk and complaint mechanisms to address protection violation. Activity 2.1.2: Production of IEC materials for all communities Activity 2.1.3: Distribution of 5,000 dignity kits to women and girls of sexual and reproductive age Activity 2.1.4: Establishment of at least one community-based protection network per community to identify risks and respond to protection concerns. Activity 2.1.5: Undertake 3 Post Distribution Monitoring each one of the two districts.

participating-org.narrative: Agencia de Desenvolvimento Economico Local de Cabo Delgado (ADEL CD) is a representative organization made up of several local institutions (public and private), concerned with local economic development of Cabo Delgado Province. It is a non-profit organization with the aim of promoting local economic development of the Cabo Delgado Province, stimulating local economic forces in the search for opportunities and the economic potential of the province for their development.
